observations: Photo 0: Black Xbox One X console with a gold and black controller on top. Console has 'XBOX' logo on front left. Background shows blue cabinets with laptops inside, and a sign for 'HiLife Stores LTD'.
Photo 1: Same console from a different angle, showing front vents and side ports. Controller is on top. Background same as photo 0.
Photo 2: Console from front-right angle, showing 'XBOX' logo and controller. Background same. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI HILIFE STORES LTD' visible.
No games, no power cable, no disc drive visible. No screen or power-on shot.
Console appears to be in a store environment, not a home or private setting.
